title: Telemetry card variant library and rollout gesture patterns
creator: Ava Chen
description: Purpose: Build a compact, composable telemetry card component set and an interaction/gesture library that surfaces rollout state and cost signals across the Console. This ticket captures the Figma kit, token mapping, density and responsive behavior, review notes, and handoff artifacts for engineering. The telemetry card family supports: summary, trend sparkline, percentile badge, active rollout indicator, canary target chip, and cost delta microcopy. It must be configurable for compact, regular, and dense dashboard lanes, and support pinned vs ephemeral states for rollout inspection.
acceptance_criteria: Figma library with master components for TelemetryCard, TelemetryRow, VariantChip, CanaryBadge, and CostDelta available in the Console Design System file
Token mapping table exported: spacing tokens, type ramp, semantic color tokens for success/warning/error/neutral, and density tokens for compact/regular/dense
Interaction spec document with hover/press/focus states, keyboard flows, and motion reduced variants
Annotated handoff doc with data contract examples for TrendSparkline (min,max,median,series-length), and aria labels for all interactive elements
Design review sign-off from PM (Priya Ramesh) and Eng owner (Michael Ortega) recorded in comments
design_decisions: Use a single TelemetryCard master with layout variants (compact/regular/dense) rather than separate components to reduce token proliferation
Represent rollout state via a left accent rail (4px) using semantic token 'accent-rollout' to keep markers consistent across consoles
VariantChip will support three visual densities and an optional chevron for drilldown; chips are single-line, truncated with tooltip on hover
Sparklines will default to 28px width on compact lanes and 56px on regular; when series length < 6 show dot markers, else show continuous line
CostDelta microcopy uses plus/minus with color semantics and accessible contrast pairings; also include a secondary delta percent for context
Keyboard focus ring uses 'focus-2' token and persists for 2s after keyboard interaction to surface discoverability
review_feedback: PM Priya Ramesh: Request to add an explicit 'live/paused' state for rollout telemetry to avoid mistaken reads during maintenance windows
Eng Michael Ortega: Asked for detailed props list for TelemetryCard; requested prop 'fallbackVariant' for low-bandwidth clients
Accessibility reviewer Lena Park: Suggested stronger contrast in warning state; recommended aria-live region for live metrics updates
Design lead Omar Sheikh: Approved compact layout but asked for one more iteration on spacing tokens at 320px breakpoints
Solutions Architect Rachel Ng: Suggested adding a non-visual flag in the data contract to differentiate sampled vs aggregated metrics
next_steps: Address accessibility feedback: increase warning contrast and add aria-live region for live updates (owner: Diego)
Produce final prop table and example payloads for Eng by 2026-03-12 (owner: Diego)
Publish updated Figma library and bump design-system version after sign-off
Coordinate with runtime/observability team to add non-visual sampling flag to metrics payloads (contact: Rachel Ng)
Schedule follow-up sync with PM and Eng for rollout QA on 2026-03-16
